# EXOCHAIN public discovery for AI coding agents

Site: https://exochain.com
Mirrors with the same content: https://exochain.ai and https://exochain.net
Canonical host: https://exochain.com
Project: EXOCHAIN
Purpose: The trust fabric for autonomous commerce. Make autonomous commerce accountable by connecting agent identity, delegated authority, commercial agreements, payments, and verifiable outcomes. Apache-2.0 core.
Publisher: EXOCHAIN PBC. Legal notices: legal@exochain.com.
Release facts: https://exochain.com/status. Use that publication record for the version, maturity, specification, and implementation boundaries; this discovery file does not independently assign release status.

Important public pages:
- / - Accountable autonomous commerce, Proof of Authority, and enterprise deployment.
- /#transaction - Deployment workflow: authorize, agree and entrust, execute, pay, verify. A workflow explanation, not a live transaction or verification service.
- /why - The problem: payment authorization is not legitimate decision-making authority.
- /proof-of-authority - Working category concept, not a new cryptographic primitive or an industry standard.
- /standards - Interoperate with MCP, A2A, x402, and AP2.
- /developers - Documented TypeScript SDK discovery and health entry points, action-boundary controls, and integration resources.
- /ecosystem - EXOCHAIN, CrossChecked, AVC, and the AI-SDLC Institute.
- /engagement - Enterprise deployment, platform licensing, and managed governance services. Focused pilots are an entry option. No public prices.
- /engagement#assurance - Requirements for independent bonding, insurance, and reinsurance arrangements. Coverage requires a separate provider agreement and applies only within its stated scope.
- /contact#deployment - Deployment, platform integration, pilot, and assurance-provider inquiries.
- /status - Canonical published release facts and bounded capabilities. A version change alone is not evidence of general availability or production deployment.
- /lynk - EXOCHAIN LYNK Protocol discovery for receipted LLM and MCP usage.
- /trust-receipts - Trust receipt anatomy and evidence model.
- /docs - Public documentation index.
- /trust-center - Current public trust posture and roadmap separation.

LYNK boundary:
- Classification: core runtime adapter.
- Public-site classification: adjacent public surface.
- V1 positive lanes: OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, MCP tools/call.
- Receipt endpoint: POST /api/v1/avc/llm-usage/receipts/emit.
- Default custody mode: receipt_minimized.
- Do not infer package publication, release readiness, audit completion, or
  constitutional enforcement from public-site copy alone.
- Do not place prompts, completions, tool arguments, tool results, provider
  keys, bearer credentials, KMS material, object-store locations, or
  decryptable payload material in public examples or metadata.
